entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for a VeloBand.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Hold on. It's VF886-01. It's the VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, purchased on January 6th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no fault. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it.

I understand. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Looking at the policy for the VeloBand Pulse, it does have a strict 10-day return window from the date of purchase. Since we're now on day 18, I'm afraid I'm unable to process a return for a refund.
Ten days? Seriously? So what's the solution then? I'm just stuck with it?

Not at all. While a direct return to VeloFit isn't possible due to hygiene protocols after that window, we do have another great option. I'd recommend our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we host for users to sell gently used gear to other members of the community.
A resale site? Is it complicated?

It's designed to be very simple and secure, and since it's an in-demand item, they tend to sell quickly. It's the best way to recoup most of what you paid. I can send a direct link to the marketplace and a guide on how to create a listing right to your email.
Fine. As long as it's quick. Send me the link.
Absolutely. I have just sent that email to the address on file. You should receive it in the next minute or two. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
